ask: Ask our X followers which feature we should build next: dark mode, exports or an iPad app.

steps.why: The question is the post's text; the options are a setting on the post. Bolta refuses media-only posts to X, so the text is always there.

On X a poll is post_type POLL: 2 to 4 options of 25 characters, 5 minutes to 7 days (poll_duration_minutes 5 to 10080, default 1440). Bolta refuses values outside these when it saves the setting; without post_type POLL the options are not sent and the post goes out plain.

say: Saved to Acme as an X draft: a one-day poll with Dark mode, Exports and iPad app. Nothing goes out yet. Schedule it?
never: Sending the poll in the poll field of the post: that one is for Threads.
A poll on a post with several parts: in a thread the poll is dropped.
